This land is in the North West, good sorghum country, but the soil here tires easily so I must put fertilizer if I want a proper harvest. I will buy one or two bags of NPK and some urea at planting and top-dress — not too much, because prices are high this year and my plot is 1.36 hectares. My seed I keep from last season, like my father did; the local sorghum does well enough with our rains, and improved seed is not easy to find here. I will work the plot with my family, but at weeding and harvest I will call a few young men to help because I am 55 and this plot is not small.
